title: Packs and opening them
summary: Packs arrive as sealed boxes in TCG Card Shop Simulator: you order them, they are stored or shelved, and they can be opened by hand or by an automatic opener you unlock.
body: Packaging boxes come in more than one kind, including boxes for cards, for items and for shelves, so where you put a box matters.
Opening packs is a physical action in the shop, and an automatic opener exists for doing it in bulk.
The automatic opener keeps its own progress, so it resumes where it left off between sessions.
What this entry does not tell you: box prices, how many cards a pack contains, or the odds of any rarity. We have not verified those numbers, so we do not print them.

facts.claim: Packaging boxes come in separate kinds for cards, items and shelves.
The automatic opener keeps saved progress.
A pack has a mesh and materials of its own, including one for a named line, and a second version of itself.
facts.evidence: asset names: CardPackStaticMesh, CardPackMat_GhostMegabot, CardPack_second, CardPackStaticMeshOptimized

facts.claim: Opening a pack has an animation and a controller of its own, and the build names three opening sounds and a vibration to go with them.
facts.evidence: asset names: PackOpenAnim, PackOpenController, SFX_PackOpening1, SFX_PackOpening2, SFX_PackOpening3, SFX_OpenPack_Vibration

facts.claim: The packaging box has an open and a closed form of its own, a smaller version and a rig that goes with it.
facts.evidence: asset names: PackagingBox01_Open, PackagingBox01_Close, PackagingBox_Small, PackagingBox01_RigAvatar

facts.claim: The automatic opener is shipped in further variants, with a second and a third interactable and a set of placed openers.
The pack-opening screen has a section text and a speed slider of its own, with a pack array material behind the packs.
facts.evidence: asset names: OpenPack Section Text, OpenPackSpeed Slider, CardPackArrayMaterial
